WITH RepCustomerCounts AS (
    SELECT
        e.EmployeeId,
        e.City,
        COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
    FROM Employee e
    JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
    GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
RepCityAverages AS (
    SELECT
        City,
        AVG(CustomerCount) AS CityAverage
    FROM RepCustomerCounts
    GROUP BY City
),
AboveAverageReps AS (
    SELECT
        r.EmployeeId,
        r.City,
        r.CustomerCount,
        a.CityAverage
    FROM RepCustomerCounts r
    JOIN RepCityAverages a ON r.City = a.City
    WHERE r.CustomerCount > a.CityAverage
)
SELECT
    City,
    SUM(CustomerCount) AS TotalCustomers,
    AVG(CustomerCount - CityAverage) AS AverageAboveCityAverage,
    AVG(1.0 * CustomerCount / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer)) AS AverageRepShareOfOverallCustomers
FROM AboveAverageReps
GROUP BY City;
